cards.card_text: When the famine spreads over all the land, Joseph opens up all the storehouses.
cards.verse_text: When the famine had spread over all the land, Joseph opened up all the storehouses and sold grain to the Egyptians; for the famine was severe in the land of Egypt.

cards.card_text: Moses calls the heavens the LORD's abundant storehouse.
cards.verse_text: The LORD will open the heavens, His abundant storehouse, to send rain on your land in season and to bless all the work of your hands.

cards.card_text: The storehouses The altar The music
cards.verse_text: The lot for the South Gate fell to Obed-edom, and the lot for the storehouses to his sons.
cards.snippet: …for the South Gate fell to Obed-edom, and the lot for the storehouses to his sons.

cards.card_text: Each day, Levites stand guard all around, from six on the east to two pairs at the storehouse to four at the highway on the west.
cards.verse_text: Each day there were six Levites on the east, four on the north, four on the south, and two pairs at the storehouse.
cards.snippet: …on the north, four on the south, and two pairs at the storehouse.

cards.card_text: Next up are the officials in charge of King David's property: his storehouses, his land and his animals.
cards.verse_text: Azmaveth son of Adiel was in charge of the royal storehouses.
cards.snippet: Azmaveth son of Adiel was in charge of the royal storehouses.

cards.card_text: Hezekiah has very great riches and honor, with treasuries and storehouses to hold it all, because God gave him very great wealth.
cards.verse_text: He also made storehouses for the harvest of grain and new wine and oil, stalls for all kinds of livestock, and pens for the flocks.
cards.snippet: He also made storehouses for the harvest of grain and new wine and oil, stalls for…

cards.card_text: Now the LORD asks if Job has entered the storehouses of snow or seen the storehouses of hail.
cards.verse_text: Have you entered the storehouses of snow or observed the storehouses of hail,
cards.snippet: Have you entered the storehouses of snow or observed the storehouses of hail,

cards.card_text: The LORD piles up the waters of the sea and puts the depths into storehouses.
cards.verse_text: He piles up the waters of the sea; He puts the depths into storehouses.
cards.snippet: …piles up the waters of the sea; He puts the depths into storehouses.

cards.card_text: The psalm says the LORD brings forth the wind from His storehouses.
cards.verse_text: He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.
cards.snippet: …the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.

cards.card_text: Then David pictures the farms: storehouses full of every kind of produce, flocks in the tens of thousands, and oxen bearing great loads.
cards.verse_text: Our storehouses will be full, supplying all manner of produce; our flocks will bring forth thousands, tens of thousands in our fields.
cards.snippet: Our storehouses will be full, supplying all manner of produce; our flocks will bring…

cards.card_text: The LORD will be the sure foundation for your times, a storehouse of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge.
cards.verse_text: He will be the sure foundation for your times, a storehouse of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge.
cards.snippet: He will be the sure foundation for your times, a storehouse of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge.

cards.card_text: With the LORD as that kind of storehouse, what does Isaiah call Zion's treasure?
cards.verse_text: He will be the sure foundation for your times, a storehouse of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge.
cards.snippet: He will be the sure foundation for your times, a storehouse of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge.

cards.card_text: The LORD makes the clouds rise from the ends of the earth, sends lightning with the rain and brings the wind out of His storehouses.
cards.verse_text: He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.
cards.snippet: …the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.

cards.card_text: Ebed-melech grabs old rags and worn-out clothes from a place below the palace storehouse and lowers them with ropes to Jeremiah.
cards.verse_text: Then Ebed-melech took the men with him and went to the king’s palace, to a place below the storehouse.
cards.snippet: …him and went to the king’s palace, to a place below the storehouse.

cards.card_text: Then the prophecy turns to the LORD Himself: He made the earth by His power, and when He thunders, the waters in the heavens roar and He brings the wind out of His storehouses.
cards.verse_text: He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.
cards.snippet: …the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.

cards.card_text: The seeds lie shriveled under the clods, and the storehouses are in ruins.
cards.verse_text: The seeds lie shriveled beneath the clods; the storehouses are in ruins; the granaries are broken down, for the grain has withered away.

cards.card_text: So the LORD gives them the fix, and it's not a few crumbs off the edge of the tray: bring the FULL tithe into the storehouse.
cards.verse_text: Bring the full tithe into the storehouse, so that there may be food in My house.
cards.snippet: Bring the full tithe into the storehouse, so that there may be food in My house.

cards.card_text: The LORD says to bring the full tithe into the storehouse, so that there may be ___ in His house.
cards.verse_text: Bring the full tithe into the storehouse, so that there may be food in My house.
cards.snippet: Bring the full tithe into the storehouse, so that there may be food in My house.

cards.card_text: Then Jesus says to consider the ravens: they don't sow or reap, and they have no storehouse or barn.
cards.verse_text: Consider the ravens: They do not sow or reap, they have no storehouse or barn; yet God feeds them.
cards.snippet: Consider the ravens: They do not sow or reap, they have no storehouse or barn; yet God feeds them.

cards.card_text: Jesus says the ravens go hungry because they have no storehouse or barn.
